description_en: Updates the configuration of a specified waiting room
description_zh: 更新指定等候室的配置信息
name: UpdateWaitingRoom

parameters.help_en: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The waiting room ID, which can be obtained by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850279.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 等候室ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850279.html接口获取
parameters.name: waiting_room_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the waiting room. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
等候室启用状态。取值：

on: 启用等候室
off: 禁用等候室
parameters.name: enable

parameters.help_en: The name of the waiting room
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to queue all visitors. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
全部排队。取值：

on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: queue_all_enable

parameters.help_en: The total number of active users
parameters.name: total_active_users

parameters.help_en: The number of new users per minute
parameters.name: new_users_per_minute

parameters.help_zh: 用户会话持续时间（分钟）
parameters.name: session_duration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to disable session renewal. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
禁用会话续订。取值：

on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: disable_session_renewal_enable

parameters.help_en:
The queuing method. Valid values:

random: random.
fifo: first-in, first-out.
passthrough: passthrough.
reject-all: reject all
parameters.help_zh:
排队方式。取值：

random：随机。
fifo：先进先出。
passthrough：直通。
reject-all：拒绝全部
parameters.name: queuing_method

parameters.help_en:
The status code returned by the waiting room. Valid values:

200
202
429
parameters.name: queuing_status_code

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable JSON response. If enabled, requests with an Accept header containing "application/json" return JSON data. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
JSON响应。开启后accept请求头包含"application/json"会返回JSON数据。取值：

on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: json_response_enable

parameters.help_en: The description of the waiting room
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The type of the waiting room. Valid values:

default: default type.
custom: custom type
parameters.help_zh:
等候室类型。支持以下类型：

default：默认类型。
custom：自定义类型
parameters.name: waiting_room_type

parameters.help_en: The custom waiting room page content. This parameter is required when the waiting room type is set to custom. The content must be in Base64 encoding
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义等候室页面内容，当等候室类型为自定义类型时，需要传入。传入的内容需要经过base64编码
parameters.name: custom_page_html

parameters.help_en:
The language of the waiting room page. This parameter is required when the waiting room type is set to default. Valid values:

enus: English.
zhcn: Simplified Chinese.
zhhk: Traditional Chinese
parameters.help_zh:
等候室页面的语言，当等候室类型为默认类型时，需要传入。支持以下类型：

enus：英文。
zhcn：中文简体。
zhhk：中文繁体
parameters.name: language
